title: Optimal Deterministic Oracle Complexity for Weakly Convex Optimization
summary: We study the oracle complexity of finding $ε$-stationary points of $ρ$-weakly convex and $G$-Lipschitz functions, where stationarity is measured by the gradient of the Moreau envelope. We consider a first-order oracle that returns both the function value and the full subdifferential at every query point. We prove that every deterministic first-order algorithm requires $ Ω({ρG^2Δ}/{ε^4})$ oracle queries whenever $Δ\leq {G^2}/ρ$, where $f(\bz)-\inf f \leq Δ$.
